{{Quote|That wasn't too bad|[[Tobb Jadak]], describing the wake rotation before the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Stellar Envoy]]''{{'s}} systems died|<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
'''Wake rotation''' was a term used to describe shuddering and groaning that a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] experienced while entering or exiting [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="MF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wake rotation was first mentioned in the [[James Luceno]] novel ''[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|Millennium Falcon]]'', released in [[2008]].<ref name="MF" /> The term was first proposed by [[Curtis Saxton]] on his [[Curtis Saxton|''Star Wars Technical Commentaries'']] fan site.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/swtc/hyperspace.html|text=Hyperspace at the [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]]|archivedate=20211126023454}}</ref>
